ale: ala — ala (a demon-ogress); gen. case sg.
batinom: batina — stick, cudgel; instr. case sg.
batinu: batina — stick, cudgel; acc. case sg.
bivala: bivati — to become, to be; past fem. sg.
boga: bog; acc. case: molim boga — I pray to God
bude: biti — to be; zna da bude — it happens
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
dosta: adverb: quite a lot; dosta dobro — quite good
dovela: dovesti — to bring, to lead; past fem. sg.
dukati: dukat — ducat (gold coin); nom. case pl.
eje: noun pl., in a list of animals
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
gde: gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
grdila: grditi — to scold; past fem. sg.
htela: hteti — to want; past, fem.; htela bih — I would like
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ide: ići — to go, to ride; gde se ide — where you need to go
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
iskoče: iskočiti — to jump out; 3rd pers. pl.
ispiju: ispiti — to drink up; 3rd pers. pl.
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
jesi: biti, 2nd pers. sg., full form; in questions: jesi siguran? — you're sure?
jeste: biti, 3rd pers. sg., full stress form
ko: ko zna — who knows; colloquial abbreviation of kao — «how»
kod: preposition + gen. case: kod stadiona — by the stadium; noun masc. — «code» (promo code)
kući: kuća — house; idemo kući — we're driving home
majko: majka; voc. case: oj, majko! — exclamation
mater: mati; acc. case: u božiju mater — to hell
mogu: moći — to be able; 1st pers. sg. (also 3rd pers. pl. — «they can»)
može: moći — to be able; 3rd pers. sg.; «može» — «all right, it's okay»
mrzila: mrziti — to hate; past fem. sg.
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
nadvire: nadvirivati se — to peer over; 3rd pers. pl.
nahranila: nahraniti — to feed; past fem. sg.
nahranjena: nahranjen — fed; nom. case fem. sg.
naiđe: naići — to run into, to appear; 3rd pers. sg.
naloži: naložiti — to light, to add (fuel); 3rd pers. sg.
naložila: naložiti — to light, to add (fuel); past fem. sg.
nepočišćena: nepočišćen — uncleaned; nom. case fem. sg.
nestalo: nestati — to disappear; past neut. sg.
ni: nije čak ni selo — this is not even a village
nisam: negation of auxiliary verba, 1st pers. sg.
nisi: negation of auxiliary verba, 2nd pers. sg.
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
njega: on — he; gen./acc. case: pored njega — past him
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
odbije: odbiti — to refuse, to reject; 3rd pers. sg., future (with «da»)
odnese: odneti — to carry away; 3rd pers. sg.
onako: čisto onako — just like that, simply
otera: oterati — to drive away; 3rd pers. sg.
otide: otići — to go away; 3rd pers. sg.
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
poište: poiskati — to search for lice; 3rd pers. sg.
poišti: poiskati — to search for lice; imperative
ponesi: poneti — to take along; imperative, sg.
počisti: počistiti — to clean up; 3rd pers. sg.
počistila: počistiti — to clean up; past fem. sg.
počne: početi; 3rd pers. sg.: neka počne — let it begin
puna: pun — full; fem.; puna sela — full of villages
rajska: rajski — heavenly; nom. case fem. sg.
rastera: rasterati — to drive apart; 3rd pers. sg.
raziđe: razići se — to disperse; 3rd pers. sg.
raštrkana: raštrkan — scattered; nom. case fem. sg.
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
sad: = sada; e sad — well then, so
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said; also «myself»: sam sebi — to oneself
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
sedne: sesti — to sit down; 3rd pers. sg.
si: biti, 2nd pers. sg.; gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
skloni: skloniti — to put away; 3rd pers. sg.
skupiše: skupiti se — to gather; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
služila: služiti — to serve; past fem. sg.
smotri: smotriti — to spot, to notice; 3rd pers. sg.
stajala: stajati (nekome) — to go, to suit; lepo ti stoji — it suits you
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
sveta: svet; gen. case: širom sveta — all over the world
svetli: svetleti — to shine, to glow; 3rd pers. sg.
svetlila: svetliti — to shine; past fem. sg.
teškom: težak — heavy; loc. case masc. sg.
ti: pronoun «you»; short form «you (dat.)» (gde ti je telefon — where is your phone)
tukla: tući — to beat; past fem. sg.
tumarala: tumarati — to wander; past fem. sg.
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
ujutru: u šest ujutru — at six in the morning
već: adverb «already»; after negation — «a» (nije selo već gradić)
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zaiđe: zaći — to stray into; 3rd pers. sg.
zapita: zapitati — to ask; past 3rd pers. sg.
zapovedi: zapovediti — to order; 3rd pers. sg. past
zaslužila: zaslužiti — to deserve; past fem. sg.
zaviri: zaviriti — to peek in; 3rd pers. sg.
zgorela: zgoreti — to burn down; past fem. sg.
čistila: čistiti — to clean; past fem. sg.
đavolska: đavolski — devilish; nom. case fem. sg.
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
živinu: živina — livestock, animals; acc. case sg.
